company.name: Elementary
company.shortDescription: Elementary designs and develops the open source elementary OS computer operating system along with its apps and services.
company.description:
Elementary designs and develops the open source elementary computer operating systems along with its applications and services. The application ships with a curated selection of applications that caters to everyday needs. AppCenter brings handcrafted apps and extensions to desktops. It allows its users to discover new apps and update the existing apps. Individuals can explore apps by the grid view, categories, and using search. The characteristics of the application are it is open source, no advertisements and spying, and secure. The website contains an online store that comprises of t-shirts for men and women and coffee mugs.

Elementary is a U.S.-based company that was founded by Cassidy James.
